sentences.en: The bank reassured us that our money was safe.
sentences.zh: 银行向我们保证我们的钱是安全的。

sentences.en: I reassured him that I would not be late.
sentences.zh: 我让他放心，我不会迟到的。

sentences.en: In spite of everything, she was expecting reassuring words from him.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，她还是期待着他能给她一些安慰的话。

senses.zh: 使安心；使消除疑虑；安慰；重新保证，再次确保；（尤指保险）分保，给……再保险
